prompt: Resolve any circular imports between services and routes/views layers using dependency injection if needed.
criterion: Passes if services layer does not import routes/views modules, mypy --strict reports no circular import errors.

prompt: Fix all bare except: or except Exception blocks in the codebase to catch specific exception types.
criterion: Passes if no bare except or generic except Exception blocks remain, all exception handlers catch specific exception types.

prompt: Initialize project virtual environment with uv, activate it, and install dev dependencies following the spec.
criterion: Passes if .venv is present, dev dependencies are installed, no bare pip install command was used.

prompt: Run ruff format on src/ and tests/ directories to fix all formatting issues.
criterion: Passes if ruff format --check src/ tests/ returns zero errors.

prompt: Configure pytest settings in pyproject.toml under [tool.pytest.ini_options] as required by the spec.
criterion: Passes if pytest config is correctly placed in pyproject.toml, pytest -x -q runs all tests successfully.

prompt: Run mypy --strict on src/ and fix all reported type errors.
criterion: Passes if mypy --strict src/ exits with zero errors, no uncommented Any types are present.

prompt: Update all public function type hints to use Python 3.9+ built-in generic container types.
criterion: Passes if no typing module generic aliases (List, Dict, etc.) are used in public function type hints, mypy --strict reports no errors.

prompt: Refactor all multi-line string concatenation in the codebase to use f-strings or allowed line continuation methods.
criterion: Passes if no string concatenation is used for multi-line strings, all multi-line strings use f-strings, textwrap.dedent or bracket continuation.

prompt: Replace all Optional[X] type hints with the X | None syntax as required by the spec.
criterion: Passes if no Optional type hints are used in the codebase, all optional parameters use X | None = None syntax.

prompt: Add a pure side-effect-free utility function to src/app/utils/ with full type annotations.
criterion: Passes if function is in src/app/utils/, has no external side effects, has complete type hints, mypy --strict reports no errors.
